## Services
- Water heaters: Hot water tanks replaced at a fair price.
- Water softeners: Softener installs, priced right.
- Leak repair: Leaks under the sink and in older pipes, found and fixed.
- Faucets: Damaged faucets replaced, quick and clean.

## Questions customers ask
- **Do you replace water heaters?** Yes. Replacing hot water tanks is one of the jobs customers mention, and they say the price was fair.
- **Do you install water softeners?** Yes. Reviewers mention water softener installs at a good price.
- **How fast can you come out?** Customers say Jeff came out the same day or the next day, and one said the problem was diagnosed and fixed in under half an hour. Call (435) 680-0111 to check today's schedule.
- **Can you fix older plumbing?** Yes. One customer had a leak in an older-style pipe that's hard to find parts for, and Jeff worked around it and ordered the parts right away.
- **What areas do you serve?** We serve Hurricane, La Verkin and nearby. Not sure if you're in range? Give us a call.
